_what: Metacheck action-type table (Seed C, 'gate by action type, not by a number'). A card whose action is one of the HELD types gets a deferred, fresh-context re-check of its key fact before the owner reads it. The hold can only ADD a check; it never removes or weakens the owner's tap, and no number or confidence is ever shown. At most 5 held types. An organization copies this file and names its own exec kinds, markers and audiences; the engine code never names a system of record, a channel product or a person.

lines.confirmed: verifier re-checked this: it matches the source
lines.discrepancy: verifier found a difference, needs your read
lines.timeout: verifier timed out, verify by hand
lines.waiting_office: held until the office opens; the re-check timed out after hours

send_customer_email.reason: re-check the recipient, the date and any amount in this email before it is sent

send_customer_text.reason: re-check the day, the time and the name in this text before it is sent

send_staff_message.reason: re-check the fact this message states before it goes to a colleague

record_write.reason: re-check the record id, the status and the date before the system of record is written

payment.reason: re-check the amount, the payee and the invoice before money moves
